With the rapid development of AI technology, more and more fast-fashion e-commerce companies are exploring how to apply AI agents comprehensively across business scenarios—whether it's smart outfit recommendations, real-time inventory lookup, return and exchange handling, or fashion trend analysis. However, moving AI agents from proof of concept to production often brings huge technical challenges: how to handle traffic spikes during promotional seasons? How to ensure personalized experiences for millions of users? How to maintain data security while guaranteeing response speed? In this article, we will introduce AgentCore Runtime, the core component of AgentCore that enables you to deploy and run efficient agents securely and at scale using "any framework and model". For fast-fashion e-commerce companies, this means you can quickly build intelligent customer service agents to handle massive inquiries, deploy outfit recommendation agents to improve conversion rates, and run inventory management agents to optimize supply chains—all with the scale, reliability, and security required for real-world deployment. AgentCore Runtime provides tools and features that make agents more effective and powerful, provides purpose-built infrastructure to securely scale agents, and provides controls for running trustworthy agents. AgentCore Runtime services work with popular open-source frameworks and any model, so you don't have to choose between open-source flexibility and enterprise-grade security and reliability.
